# Parag Rahangdale

> INSEAD MBA candidate based in Singapore, targeting product manager and program manager roles. Leads cross-functional delivery, turns customer and business needs into product priorities, and ships work that moves commercial metrics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://parag08.github.io/): Scroll-driven mountain journey through career history, experience and education.
- [Case studies](https://parag08.github.io/work.html): Save-file index of case studies: files migration and ESXi-to-AHV conversion at Nutanix, route optimisation at Valeo Health, AI-enabled investment platform at Strymin (formerly EverHaus Group).
- [Nutanix files migration](https://parag08.github.io/work/nutanix-files-migration/): Took over a files migration stalled for two years, set the Move/Files team boundary, cleared ~300 QA bugs in six weeks and shipped on time; 10+ PB migrated and $1M+ recurring revenue in year one.
- [Nutanix ESXi to AHV](https://parag08.github.io/work/nutanix-esxi-to-ahv/): Led Nutanix Move's in-place ESXi-to-AHV conversion across the AHV, Networking and Uhura teams after VMware's licensing change; shipped on time and kept about half of ~2,000 affected enterprise customers.
- [Valeo Health routing](https://parag08.github.io/work/valeo-health/): Traced an 18% fleet-cost rise from receipts, won CEO approval for three strategies, and built Logistics Valeo with operations: orders captured rose from 60–70% to 80–90%, km per order fell ~25%, adopted in a week.
- [Projects](https://parag08.github.io/projects.html): Case studies, working demos and project summaries for platforms and tools built, scaled or turned around.
- [Old Site](https://parag08.github.io/old-site.html): Previous homepage with a 3D workspace, selected impact metrics, skills and project links.
- [Contact](https://parag08.github.io/contact.html): Email, LinkedIn and résumé.
